mapProfile.cameraFraming: Keep both formation caverns, the central limestone sink, the western and eastern shelves, and all three reconnecting passages readable in the production isometric camera.

styleAuthority.usage: Use the image for limestone material, cavern scale, light hierarchy, and spatial motifs; derive gameplay topology from this semantic contract.

composition.summary: An irregular limestone cavern organized around a shallow central sink, a broad southern formation chamber, a smaller northern grotto, and western and eastern shelves joined by three reconnecting natural passages.
visualHierarchy: A broad southern limestone chamber anchors the scene and provides the principal open formation ground without touching a flat map edge.
A smaller northern crystal-lit grotto provides a distinct opposing formation ground.
A shallow central sink with broken limestone columns divides sightlines without becoming an impassable moat.
Western flowstone terraces and an eastern stalagmite shelf frame two outer approaches that reconnect beyond the sink.
Layered cavern walls, stalagmites, rubble, and shadowed fissures own the irregular outer boundary.
focalAreas: shallow central sink and broken limestone columns
negativeSpace: Keep irregular open floor inside both formation caverns for readable tactical groupings.
Preserve broad navigable gaps around both sides of the central sink and broken columns.
Keep passage mouths and elevation transitions visually separate from solid cavern walls.
Avoid large featureless black voids that obscure the playable silhouette.
density: Open pale limestone floor in the southern chamber.
Moderate crystal, calcite, and rubble detail around the northern grotto and route junctions.
Dense stalagmites, broken columns, flowstone, and dark rock along the irregular boundary.
Sparse floor accents inside movement lanes and formation clearings.

areas.description: A broad irregular limestone chamber with maneuvering room and three distinct exits.
A smaller elevated grotto with local cover and three distinct entries.
A shallow crossable depression with broken columns and multiple passages around its edges.
A broad connected limestone shelf reached by natural ramps and a short carved stair.
A lower curving shelf whose stalagmite clusters shape cover without closing the route.

relationships.kind: two broad curved descents around broken limestone columns
reconnecting natural ramps and a short carved stair
wide ascending passage with a natural slope and a readable stair branch
curved upper passage reconnecting beyond the central sink
broad low passage bending between sparse stalagmite clusters
reconnecting eastern ramp beyond the central sink

connections: Use broad natural limestone ramps for most level changes.
Use a small number of short carved stone stairs where terraces meet main routes.
Keep the central sink shallow and walkable, with at least two broad visibly sloped descents on both its southern and northern sides and no continuous raised rim.
Keep every shelf connected; do not create isolated rock pillars or detached platforms.

primaryApproaches: Provide three tactically distinct route families between the formation caverns: through the central sink, across the western terrace, and around the eastern shelf.
Keep three independent passage mouths at both formation caverns; interconnect the route families only at multiple mid-map junctions without merging them into a shared throat near either formation.
Bend routes around limestone columns, stalagmites, shelves, and rubble rather than drawing straight mine corridors.
secondaryApproaches: Branch both outer shelves back toward the central sink to prevent corridor play.
Use a mixture of broad ramps and short stairs so elevation changes remain readable.
Preserve multiple passage mouths around every major landmark.

boundaryIntent.description: Natural limestone walls, flowstone, stalagmites, rubble, and shadowed fissures own an uneven cave edge; never resolve the playable or rendered perimeter into a rectangular room or continuous constructed wall.

spawnIntent.formationCharacter: Opposing formations occupy the broad southern cavern and smaller northern grotto, each with local cover, irregular maneuvering room, and access to all three reconnecting passage families.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not place candidates on detached shelves or pillars.
Do not reserve a full-height or full-width cleared spawn strip.
Do not mirror or regularize the two formation caverns.
Do not make either formation depend on one choke, ramp, stair, or sink crossing.
Do not infer exact spawn coordinates by literally tracing the source image.

requiredLandmarks: broad natural ramps and a few short carved stairs
forbiddenPatterns: rectangular dungeon room or arena perimeter
detached spawn pads, shelves, or pillars
single-choke formations, routes, ramps, stairs, or sink crossings
large opaque black voids over playable space
literal pixel, coordinate, or contour tracing
